newsitem.title: USA: Excel may close Rockford, Illinois, plant.
newsitem.headline: Excel may close Rockford, Illinois, plant.

text.p: Excel Industries Inc on Friday said it made a preliminary decision to close its Eddy Avenue plant in Rockford, Ill., possibly affecting about 300 workers.

If the decision becomes final, the shutdown is expected to occur on or before July 31, Excel said. The company said it expected to record an undetermined restructuring reserve for the closing in the first quarter.
"The company will discuss its decision with the United Auto Workers union, which represents hourly employees at the facility," Excel said.
The Eddy Avenue plant is one of seven that Excel added through its acquisition of Anderson Industries in April, it said.

"Excess automotive capacity and the need for substantial capital expenditures to improve manufacturing standards at this facility led to the closure decision," said the manufacturer of vehicle components.
